{{hatnote|This page documents the historical PHP-Nuke Encyclopedia module on the official Players Committee site swccgpc.com (archived 2008). It is not a card-by-card encyclopedia and does not replace live card pages on this wiki.}}

The '''swccgpc.com Encyclopedia''' was a PHP-Nuke '''Encyclopedia''' module on the official Star Wars CCG Players Committee website at [http://www.swccgpc.com/ swccgpc.com]. In August 2008 it was a '''player-resource hub''' (rules, virtual cards, tournaments, volunteers, tools, store, and premium membership), not an A&ndash;Z card encyclopedia.<ref name="enc2008">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080831140913/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia], swccgpc.com modules.php?name=Encyclopedia (Wayback, 31 August 2008)</ref>

Parent narrative: [[History of the Players Committee]]. Domain context: [[Swccgpc.com]]. Advocate roster from the Volunteer category: [[Players Committee advocates#Snapshot ~August 2008 (Encyclopedia Volunteer Information)]].

== What it was (Aug 2008) ==

The Encyclopedia index is a '''list of available Encyclopedias''': nine PHP-Nuke categories, each with an ''eid'' value.<ref name="enc2008" />

{| class="wikitable"
! eid
! Category title (as listed)
! Notes (from 31 Aug 2008 capture)
|-
| 3
| Rules Resources
| Rules Advocate contact; Advanced Rulebook (legal 29 July 2007); Advanced Rulebook Quarterly Update (legal July 2008); Online Rules Document; Characteristics Reference Card; Icon Guide; rules forum; Spanish resources
|-
| 5
| Virtual Card Resources
| Links to all Virtual Card files / game aids / errata sheets; listing of Virtual card errata; Enhanced Packs / Special Virtual Slips
|-
| 6
| Tournament Resources
| Tournament Advocate contact; PC Store; Command Card; Decklists; Tournament Guide; Player Locator; Cube / Scenario formats; posting guidance; 2008 results
|-
| 7
| Volunteer Information
| Named '''Advocate Council''', key volunteers, and '''Flight Leaders''' (regional contacts)&mdash;see [[Players Committee advocates#Snapshot ~August 2008 (Encyclopedia Volunteer Information)]]
|-
| 8
| General Resources
| Community tools of the era (e.g. sw-ip, vkit, Polarhaven, Holotable); card image database; sales/auction/trading/collecting forums
|-
| 9
| Marketing Resources
| Marketing Advocate; marketing forum; in-store posters / banner ads
|-
| 10
| New Player Resource
| New Player Forum pointer; cross-links to Virtual / Tournament / Rules resources
|-
| 11
| shop.swccgpc.com - The PC Store
| Store for tournament registrations, prize packages, cards
|-
| 12
| Premium Membership
| Paid forum tiers (6-month $15 / 12-month $25 / Lifetime $150) with private forums, earlier decklist visibility, full Virtual PDFs, Worlds entry discount, custom avatars / blogs
|}

== Relationship to other sources ==

* Mid-2006 '''Advocates''' roster on the same domain was a separate PHP-Nuke '''Content''' page (pid=3), not this Encyclopedia module.<ref name="advocates2006enc">[https://web.archive.org/web/20060617221233/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Content&pa=showpage&pid=3 Advocates], swccgpc.com Content pid=3 (published 2006-05-01; Wayback capture 17 June 2006)</ref>
* Domain/server move to '''starwarsccg.org''' was announced '''10 June 2009'''.<ref name="domain2009enc">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102740/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=69 New Domain and Server], starwarsccg.org (posted 10 June 2009; Wayback 6 July 2009)</ref>
